node.title: Re^3: What's happening in this expression? (Updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
What about my $a=$x=$y=$z = foo()
$ perl -MO=Deparse,-p -e 'my $a=$x=$y=$z = foo()' (my $a = ($x = ($y = ($z = foo()))));

The comma is left [wp://Operator associativity|associative] and the assignment is right associative. See [doc://perlop].

Here my attribute does not propogate like in case of comma.

No, it doesn't "propagate" with the comma either, [id://11122691|as I showed].
